comment: Recognition layer 3: landmark popups. Coordinates are real OSM lat/lon, projected into world space via the route origin+scale at load. radius = trigger distance in compressed-world meters. Each landmark has a stable id from creation (standing rule - the future ad system depends on this pattern). needs_owner_review = true marks entries where owner's lived knowledge should confirm or correct placement.

landmarks.name: Gun Boat Beach
landmarks.fact: Harbour-side bathing spot on the Palisadoes strip

landmarks.name: National Stadium
landmarks.fact: Home of Jamaican track and football glory — Excelsior High is just across Mountain View Avenue

landmarks.name: Excelsior High School
landmarks.fact: Opposite the National Stadium on Mountain View Ave — one of Kingston's best

landmarks.name: National Heroes Park
landmarks.fact: Jamaica's national pantheon — resting place of Norman Manley, Marcus Garvey, and other national heroes

landmarks.name: Emancipation Park
landmarks.fact: Laura Facey's bronze of two Maroons breaking free — facing north, toward freedom

landmarks.name: Bob Marley Museum
landmarks.fact: 56 Hope Road — the Tuff Gong recording studio where reggae was born

landmarks.name: Devon House
landmarks.fact: 1881 mansion of George Stiebel, Jamaica's first black millionaire — and legendary ice cream

landmarks.name: Half Way Tree Clock Tower
landmarks.fact: The 1813 clock tower at the crossroads of Kingston

landmarks.name: St. Andrew High School
landmarks.fact: Half Way Tree area — one of Jamaica's top-ranked all-girls schools

landmarks.name: Holy Childhood High
landmarks.fact: Catholic girls' school in the Half Way Tree area — long academic tradition

landmarks.name: Calabar High School
landmarks.fact: Red Hills Road — the founder's alma mater and a powerhouse in Jamaican athletics

landmarks.name: Hydel High School
landmarks.fact: On Spanish Town Road heading west — a west Kingston institution

landmarks.name: Tracks & Records
landmarks.fact: Usain Bolt's restaurant on Constant Spring Road — fastest man on Earth, finest jerk chicken

landmarks.name: Flat Bridge
landmarks.fact: Historic one-lane bridge over the Rio Cobre in Bog Walk gorge

landmarks.name: Faith's Pen
landmarks.fact: Legendary roadside stop — jerk chicken, roast yam and festival since the 1960s

landmarks.name: Dunn's River Falls
landmarks.fact: Jamaica's famous climbable waterfall — journey's end
